product.title: 4 Hour Shared Big Game Fishing

description.text: Head offshore from Fort Lauderdale for a shared deep-sea fishing trip targeting seasonal big game species with support from an experienced crew.

highlights: Shared deep-sea fishing trip from Fort Lauderdale
Crew support with gear setup and bait prep
Target seasonal game fish in offshore waters
Half-day format ideal for busy travel itineraries
